verdict.rationale: Oneleet's framework-removal docs say controls are automatically added per framework and are kept when another framework still requires them. That implies a shared control set across frameworks, so work on a control can count toward several of the supported frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, GDPR). However, this cross-framework mapping is only inferred from removal behavior, not documented directly. missing for 10: explicit documentation that SOC 2 evidence automatically satisfies ISO 27001/HIPAA requirements, any UI or report showing framework overlap, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
